notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Samira Khalid) - mid-market B2B SaaS (analytics for product teams).

Summary of needs:
- Primary: semantic search over user-generated content + docs (fast recall, good precision).
- Embeddings pipeline: nightly batch ingest of updated docs (~1M docs/month), need bulk embed throughput ~50k docs/hour for backfill, ongoing delta batches ~5k/hour.
- Vector DB integration: currently evaluating Pinecone + internal Postgres+pgvector. Want Redwood to integrate cleanly with existing Pinecone project and provide metrics on embedded throughput/cost.
- Search latency targets: median end-to-end (query -> topK results) <= 120ms for 95th percentile for the main search endpoint.
- Throughput: plan for 100 qps peak (global product), average ~20 qps. Must support autoscaling spikes to 300 qps for promotion events.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market, looking to optimize token and embed unit price; interested in batching, caching, and quantization recommendations.
- Model preferences: willing to use Redwood-curated open models (13B quant) for embeddings and a larger variant for multi-turn summarization. Want fallback to smaller quantized variant during capacity events.
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted API for speed to market; evaluate Dedicated for predictability and lower long-run unit cost. Need policy-based routing between hosted/dedicated by route and SLA.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-11-20: Intro call (AE Jordan) - product overview + high-level requirements.
- 2025-12-05: Hosted API demo (Jordan + Ravi) - walked through embeddings SDK, streaming examples.
- 2026-01-12: POC kickoff (ff_poc_kickoff_2026-01-12) - created test corpus (50k docs), started hosted-API embed tests.
- 2026-01-26: Initial embed throughput test completed - 8k docs/hr on single region hosted plan (notes: CPU-bound on client side; need parallelization).
- 2026-02-10: Product deep-dive with SE (Ravi) and infra lead (Marcus) - discussed vector DB connectors, batch ingestion patterns, S3-based batch staging. (fireflies id ff_meeting_2026-02-10_9821).
- 2026-02-25: Demo of Dedicated sizing recommendations (Ravi) - initial suggestion: 2x A100-equivalent nodes for steady 100 qps search with room to burst.
- 2026-03-03: Security checklist exchange (drive:/security/Polaris_Redwood_Security_FAQ_v1.pdf). Legal asked for data residency clause and proof of SOC2.

POC milestones and results:
- Phase 1 (hosted API): verify embed quality + latency. Outcome: embeddings quality acceptable; search recall good vs current vector DB; cost per embed roughly 18% higher than internal estimates due to small batch sizes.
- Phase 2 (throughput/runbook): test end-to-end search latency at 100 qps using hosted API + Pinecone. Outcome: median latency 95ms, p95 170ms — needs optimization. SE recommended prefix caching, local prefetch for topK rerank.
- Phase 3 (Dedicated eval): sizing workbook produced; pricing conversation open. Customer wants a deterministic SLA for p95 latency and nightly batch windows guaranteed.

Customer quotes / call snippets:
- "We love the SDK ergonomics, but we need predictable cost before committing to Dedicated." — Samira (Head of Product).
- "Nightly backfill must finish within a 6-hour window; otherwise search freshness impacted." — Marcus (Infra Lead).

Technical blockers / notes for AE/SE:
- Need a runbook showing how Redwood integrates with Pinecone vs. using host-managed VDB (explicit connector patterns).
- Customer requests a sample billing projection for hosted -> dedicated migration at 12 months of usage.
- Legal needs a draft DPA with EU data residency options even though HQ is in NA (some EU customers require it).

Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver connector reference + batch ingestion guide (end of week).
- AE to share Dedicated pricing workbook and 12-month cost projection by 2026-03-15.
- Legal to review DPA template; schedule 30-min call with customer counsel week of 2026-03-22.

Internal notes (CRM style):
- Good product-fit; reasonable ARR for mid-market seat.
- Upside: multi-product deployment (search + summarization) could expand ARR.
- Risk: budget cycle in April; if pricing not competitive, they will stick to Pinecone + in-house embeddings.
- Treat as high-priority for dedicated sales path if POC latency improvements hit p95 target <= 130ms.
